assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229
The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness
The patient has concern for symptomatic atrial fibrillation
The patient has concern for sick sinus syndrome
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is ordered to correlate episodic symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The documentation supports the medical necessity of the monitored diagnostic procedure described in the clinical indication
